review_method: Coordinator directly opened saved pixels with view_image and compared frozen criteria before receiving child pixel grades. No claim of an external blinded reviewer.
topic_observable: A working performer in a vanity room returns a wave to an album-holding remote fan displayed on a physical tablet. Cheek mic, stage jacket, star emblem, tour pass and poster form connected context.

criteria.evidence: Stage jacket, cheek microphone, vanity bulbs/tour pass and matching star emblems are jointly visible.
Bounded tablet shows a separate smiling fan holding a rose star album and waving; call controls are visible.
Lead has a small smile and lowered chin, looks toward the device, and responds with a raised palm.
Physical lead, device frame, screen fan face, album and both waving palms are legible without room/screen fusion.
00:08 is legible. This meets the frozen numeric-display criterion, not proof of a remaining countdown or an actual ending over time.
Dark chin-length bob, fine bangs and corresponding face/eye/nose/lip proportions are visible at large scale; appearance continuity only.

Hands and contacts look plausible, but the near arm from her anatomical right shoulder rests across the vanity, while the farther left arm supplies the wave. The frozen prompt requires left forearm support and right-hand wave.
Face dominates without losing readable fan/device action; warm practical light supports the closing interaction.

source_use_causal_gain: Unestablished: final prompt equals pre-retrieval baseline and used_new_CIDs is empty.
controls_pixel_description: Warmly lit clothed performer, attentive gaze and small smile; ordinary plausible vanity/call environment, no fetish prop emphasis or surreal transformation. Consistent with understated controls intent; user preference remains unassessed.
